title: ampfalaeris/envmetag pipeline parameters
description: Shotgun metagenomic profiling of environmental samples, with curated marker genes for sulfur, methane, and nitrogen cycling and hydrocarbon degradation.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

read_cleaning_options.title: Read cleaning options
read_cleaning_options.description: References used to remove PhiX and host reads. Both are fetched at runtime.

phix_fasta.description: PhiX reference FASTA (local path or URL), indexed with bowtie2 at runtime.
phix_fasta.help_text: Defaults to ENA J02482.1 (phiX174, 5,386 bp), the INSDC record RefSeq NC_001422.1 is derived from.

hostile_index.description: Hostile index name, fetched at runtime with `hostile index fetch`.
hostile_index.help_text: The default human T2T + HLA index is masked against 985 bacterial and 140 mycobacterial genomes, so environmental bacteria are less likely to be removed as host. List available indexes with `hostile index list`.

singlem_options.title: SingleM options
singlem_options.description: Read-based taxonomic profiling with SingleM on fastp-trimmed reads.

singlem_metapackage.description: Path to an extracted SingleM metapackage (`.smpkg` directory). Preferred over downloading.
singlem_metapackage.help_text: The GlobDB r232 metapackage is a 3.8 GB download and 17 GB extracted. It must be on local or shared disk: SingleM cannot read a metapackage from object storage. If not set, the pipeline downloads `--singlem_metapackage_url`, into `--singlem_db_cache` when that is set and otherwise into the work directory.

singlem_metapackage_url.description: Metapackage archive (`.smpkg.tar.gz`) to download when `--singlem_metapackage` is not set.
singlem_metapackage_url.help_text: Default: GlobDB r232 (CC BY-SA 4.0; cite GlobDB and its underlying sources, see https://globdb.org/citations).

singlem_db_cache.description: Directory to keep the downloaded, extracted metapackage across runs. Recommended when `--singlem_metapackage` is not set.
singlem_db_cache.help_text: The first run needs ~21 GB free (archive staged in the work directory plus the extracted copy). Later runs reuse the cached copy and skip the download. Without it, the metapackage is extracted in the work directory and every fresh run downloads it again.

singlem_assignment_method.description: Override SingleM's taxonomic assignment method (`singlem pipe --assignment-method`).
singlem_assignment_method.help_text: Leave unset for SingleM's default. The test profile sets `diamond` because its 3-marker CI metapackage has no nucleotide database.

report_options.title: Report options
report_options.description: Layout of the envmetag HTML report.

report_top_n.description: Taxa per rank that get their own colour in the composition plot; the rest are pooled as 'Other'.
report_top_n.help_text: Taxa are ranked by their highest relative abundance in any one sample, so a taxon that dominates a single sample keeps its own colour.

report_stacked_bar_max_samples.description: Sample count above which the report notes that the stacked-bar layout may be hard to read.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

config_profile_name.description: Name of the active config profile, shown in the run summary.

config_profile_description.description: Description of the active config profile, shown in the run summary.
